Image 1 is the owned Lyra v1 edit target and identity anchor. Preserve Lyra's exact segmented ivory porcelain cranium, narrow obsidian faceplate, two compact recessed cyan optical apertures, adult human-scale proportions, obsidian mechanics, ink-blue material family, fine warm-metal seams, and calm research-conductor identity. Make this a slight premium functional evolution, not a redesign. Remove the pedestal, floating cards, glowing chest core, ceremonial high collar, and floor-length authority coat. Give Lyra a serviceable split work mantle ending above the knees, visible articulated legs and hands, and one compact physical routing instrument: three small bounded evidence cartridges enter on one side and one sealed task packet exits toward an off-frame human reviewer. Full-body eye-level 4:5 portrait with generous edge safety in a quiet civic editorial atelier built from dark mineral plaster, warm paper, blackened steel, and daylight. Cyan appears only as low-intensity machine activity; one amber approval lamp is mounted in the environment and clearly separate from Lyra. High-fidelity tactile editorial realism, matte porcelain grain, precise seams, subtle wear, restrained contrast, no global glow. No text, logos, fake UI, holograms, floating panels, node networks, pedestal, halo, crown, throne, weapon, combat armor, superhero stance, high heels, human skin, wet eyeballs, eyelashes, lips, smile simulation, toy proportions, cute mascot schema, generic neon cyberpunk, or imitation of any named studio or living artist.
